subject: Quantara Health — Technical deep dive (Ops + ML) — scheduling and attendees
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Rossi <emma.rossi@quantara.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Quantara Health — Technical deep dive (Ops + ML) — scheduling and attendees

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery: the call confirmed that Quantara wants a 60–90 min technical deep dive for your infra and ML teams to validate latency/cost expectations, rollout patterns, and security posture (VPC/KMS).

Proposed outcomes for the session:
- Walk through a representative inference workload (model, seq length, QPS)
- Runbook for deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and fallback behavior
- SLA and observability checklist + sample dashboards
- Mutual action plan and next milestones

Availability — we can host a 60–90 min session the week of Jan 25. Two specific slots that work on our side (converted to EST below):
- Tue Jan 26, 11:00–12:15 EST (60–75 min)
- Thu Jan 28, 09:00–10:30 EST (75–90 min)

If neither works, tell me a couple of windows that week and we’ll coordinate. Please also confirm the attendee list from Quantara (ML lead + infra/ops + product).

I’m attaching a one-page mutual action plan and a draft agenda (attached) — these are sketches, we’ll lock the agenda once you confirm attendees and timing.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.pdf (1 page); tdx-agenda-draft.md

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lukas.meyer@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

From: Emma Rossi <emma.rossi@quantara.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quantara Health — Technical deep dive (Ops + ML) — scheduling and attendees

Hi Lukas — thanks for the recap and the materials. We’re excited to dig in. Quick notes from my side:
- Our ML lead (Daniel Kim) is traveling Jan 25–26 and returns late on the 26th, so Tue morning EST will be tight.
- Thu Jan 28 looks promising; we can do Thu 09:00–10:30 EST but would prefer 09:30 start if that’s okay on your end.

Attendees I expect to join:
- Emma Rossi — Product (me)
- Daniel Kim — ML Lead (daniel.kim@quantara.com)
- Priya Shah — Head of Cloud Ops (priya.shah@quantara.com)

We’d aim for ~75 minutes. Please confirm the final agenda and who from Redwood will present which section (we’d like to know who will cover runtime/latency, cost/quantization, and security).

Also — is there any pre-work we should share (sample load profile, SLOs, or a sanitized config)? Happy to send a short data pack to help the session be productive.

Best,
Emma

From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jan 2027 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Quantara Health — Technical deep dive (Ops + ML) — scheduling and attendees

Lukas / Ben — drafting a tighter agenda based on Emma’s ask and our playbook. Suggest we confirm Thu Jan 28, 09:30–10:45 EST (75 minutes). Proposed flow and owners:

1) 09:30–09:40 (10m) — Quick intros + goals for the deep dive — Lukas
2) 09:40–10:00 (20m) — Production workload mapping: expected QPS, seq lengths, token distribution — Quantara (Emma/Daniel) with clarifying Qs from Priya
3) 10:00–10:20 (20m) — Serving runtime & latency controls: batching, KV cache, kernel selection — Priya (I’ll demo prefix/caching behavior)
4) 10:20–10:30 (10m) — Cost optimization: quantization profiles, batching tradeoffs — Ben (unit economics)
5) 10:30–10:40 (10m) — Security/compliance: VPC, KMS, audit logs — Lukas/Ben (surface what’s included in Private)
6) 10:40–10:45 (5m) — Action items & next steps (mutual action plan) — Lukas

Prep requests for Quantara (small asks):
- A one-slide summary (or bullet list) of peak and steady QPS targets and a sample prompt length distribution (short/medium/long).
- Any hard latency SLOs (p50/p95) and must-have security controls.

I’ll prepare a short demo notebook and bring sample traces for the runtime section. Putting together a slide for the cost/quantization piece — Ben, I’ll work with you to tighten unit-cost examples.

If that flow looks good, I’ll update the attached agenda doc and send an updated calendar invite once Lukas confirms the time with Emma.

— Priya
Priya Natarajan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com

Emma — thanks, Thu Jan 28 at 09:30 EST works for us. I’ve tentatively locked that slot and will send the invite once you confirm attendees (Daniel + Priya Shah).

To confirm: 75-minute session on Thu Jan 28, 09:30–10:45 EST. Redwood attendees: Lukas Meyer (AE), Priya Natarajan (SE), Ben Carter (Sales Ops) — Priya will lead the runtime demo; Ben will cover cost/quantization; I’ll cover security and action items.

Prep notes: please share the short data pack (QPS & latency targets) ahead of Tue Jan 26 if possible — that gives Priya time to tailor the demo. If you prefer, use this secure upload link (one-time): https://redwood.upload/quantara/qh-tdx-452 (note: separate from the hubspot link in the metadata).

Attaching updated agenda and the mutual action plan I mentioned earlier. If anything changes on your side, let me know and we’ll pivot. Looking forward to a productive session.

Attachments: tdx-agenda-draft.md (updated), mutual_action_plan.pdf

Cheers,
